articulo: S5 · W Trek vs O Circuit: How to Choose in Torres del Paine
caption:
Not everything in Patagonia happens inside Torres del Paine: near Puerto Natales, Cueva del Milodón sits outside the national park.

It is one of several ideas for days around town, useful for rest days or a gentler pace.
